description: Build the coordinator Categories+Criteria management section: both entity lists live inside the single CoordinatorCategoriesSection.tsx (the only nav entry for either), switched via an internal 2-tab sub-switcher ("Categories" / "Criteria"), each tab rendering its own candidates-section-style list. Add six new modals: AddCategory/EditCategory/DeactivateCategory and AddCriterion/EditCriterion/DeactivateCriterion. Both entities are soft-deletes (deactivate), matching the candidate precedent's wording. Independent of FEAT-001/003/004.
steps: Read src/features/coordinator/components/modals/AddCandidates.tsx, EditCandidate.tsx, DeactivateCandidate.tsx in full as the structural template, and src/features/coordinator/hooks/useCategories.ts to confirm exact signatures (useCategories(pageantId); useCreateCategory(pageantId) takes CreateCategoryRequest; useUpdateCategory(pageantId, categoryId) takes CreateCategoryRequest (note: NOT a separate Update type — same shape); useDeactivateCategory(pageantId) takes categoryId string; and the parallel useCriteria/useCreateCriterion/useUpdateCriterion/useDeactivateCriterion with CreateCriterionRequest). Read src/types/category.ts for CategoryResponse/CriterionResponse/CreateCategoryRequest/CreateCriterionRequest shapes (note defaultMaximumScore/defaultMinimumScore are strings, Decimal-on-the-wire). Do not modify useCategories.ts or category.ts.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/AddCategory.tsx: "use client", categoryFormSchema = z.object({code: z.string().min(1).max(50), name: z.string().min(1).max(150), description: z.string().max(1000).optional(), displayOrder: z.number().int().min(0).optional()}), export schema/CategoryFormValues/Field/fieldInput tokens for EditCategory.tsx. Props {pageantId, open, onClose}, useCreateCategory(pageantId), form fields: Code, Name (2-col grid), Description (textarea, optional), Display Order (number input, optional, default 0). handleClose guards `if (createCategory.isPending) return;`. Modal size="md" (bump to "lg" only if the 2-col + textarea layout feels cramped when actually laid out — judgment call per Part A's size precedent, default to md since this form is simpler than candidates'). Toast + ApiError wired like AddCandidates.tsx.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/EditCategory.tsx mirroring EditCandidate.tsx: props {pageantId, category: CategoryResponse | null, onClose}, imports categoryFormSchema/Field/fieldInput from "./AddCategory", uses useUpdateCategory(pageantId, category?.id ?? ""), reset() from category prop via useEffect, same handleClose/Modal size as Add.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/DeactivateCategory.tsx mirroring DeactivateCandidate.tsx exactly: useDeactivateCategory(pageantId), ConfirmModal title "Deactivate Category", confirmLabel "Deactivate", description e.g. `Deactivate "${category.name}" (${category.code})? It will be excluded from judging until reactivated.`, destructive, toast on success/error.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/AddCriterion.tsx: "use client", criterionFormSchema = z.object({code: z.string().min(1).max(50), name: z.string().min(1).max(150), description: z.string().max(1000).optional(), defaultMaximumScore: z.string().min(1, "Required").regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, "Enter a valid number (up to 2 decimal places)"), defaultMinimumScore: z.string().min(1, "Required").regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, "Enter a valid number (up to 2 decimal places)")}) — optionally add a .refine() checking minimumScore <= maximumScore numerically for better UX, export schema/CriterionFormValues/Field/fieldInput for EditCriterion.tsx. Props {pageantId, open, onClose}, useCreateCriterion(pageantId), fields: Code, Name (2-col grid), Description (textarea, optional), Default Minimum Score / Default Maximum Score (2-col grid, both <input type="number" step="0.01" min="0"> registered as plain string fields via register(), no valueAsNumber). handleClose/toast/Modal size="md" (or "lg" if cramped) following the same judgment call as Category.
Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/EditCriterion.tsx mirroring EditCandidate.tsx, importing from "./AddCriterion", using useUpdateCriterion(pageantId, criterion?.id ?? "").

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/DeactivateCriterion.tsx mirroring DeactivateCandidate.tsx, using useDeactivateCriterion(pageantId), title "Deactivate Criterion", confirmLabel "Deactivate", destructive.

Rebuild src/features/coordinator/components/management/CoordinatorCategoriesSection.tsx replacing the stub: "use client", props {pageantId}, local state activeTab: "categories" | "criteria" (default "categories"), plus isAddModalOpen/editTarget/deactivateTarget state PER entity (so 6 pieces of modal state total, or two small reducers/objects if cleaner — implementer's call, keep it readable). Render a small 2-button sub-tab switcher at the top (visually lighter than the page-level MANAGEMENT_SECTIONS tab bar — e.g. a simple inline flex of two text/underline toggle buttons, not a full bordered grid) above the candidates-section-style list for whichever tab is active. Each tab's list follows CoordinatorCandidatesSection.tsx's loading/error/empty/desktop-grid+mobile-card structure independently (useCategories(pageantId) query for the categories tab, useCriteria(pageantId) for the criteria tab) — Categories list columns: Code, Name, Display Order, Status(isActive), Actions(Edit/Deactivate); Criteria list columns: Code, Name, Min Score, Max Score, Status(isActive), Actions(Edit/Deactivate). Use the same CandidateStatus-shaped active/inactive badge (bg-green-50/text-green-700/border-green-200 vs bg-slate/50/text-muted/border-border). Wire all 6 modals at the bottom of the returned JSX.
acceptance_criteria: CoordinatorCategoriesSection.tsx no longer renders the stub text and offers a working tab switch between Categories and Criteria, each with its own Add/Edit/Deactivate flow wired to the correct hooks
Both DeactivateCategory.tsx and DeactivateCriterion.tsx use 'Deactivate' wording (not 'Delete'), matching the soft-delete semantics of useDeactivateCategory/useDeactivateCriterion
The criterion form's defaultMaximumScore/defaultMinimumScore are validated as numeric strings via the regex pattern and submitted as strings (not coerced to Number) in the mutation payload
`npx tsc --noEmit` run from frontend/ exits 0 with no type errors introduced by these 7 files
verification: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit — confirm exit code 0
cd frontend && npm run build — confirm the build completes without errors

Manually re-read all 7 touched/created files end-to-end confirming: Modal size prop set deliberately on both Add/Edit pairs, handleClose pending-guards present, toast wiring present, 'Deactivate' wording on both confirm modals, and that the criterion score fields stay strings through the whole data path from input to mutateAsync payload
findings: Implemented AddCategory/EditCategory/DeactivateCategory and AddCriterion/EditCriterion/DeactivateCriterion under src/features/coordinator/components/modals/, following the AddCandidates/EditCandidate/DeactivateCandidate pattern exactly (shared Field/fieldInput/fieldLabel/fieldError tokens exported from each Add modal for its Edit modal to reuse, handleClose guards `if (mutation.isPending) return;` only — no isUploadingPhoto since neither form has an image upload). Both Category and Criterion forms used size="lg": the 2-col code/name grid plus description textarea plus (for criterion) a second 2-col min/max score grid felt cramped at md, same judgment call Part A made for candidates. Criterion form adds a .refine() cross-field check (minimumScore <= maximumScore) on top of the per-field regex, attached to the defaultMinimumScore path for the error display; defaultMaximumScore/defaultMinimumScore stay strings through register() -> onSubmit -> mutateAsync payload, no Number()/valueAsNumber coercion anywhere. Rebuilt CoordinatorCategoriesSection.tsx: a lightweight underline-style 2-tab switcher (Categories/Criteria, text-small font-semibold border-b-2, lighter than the page-level tab bar) sits above two independent list renderers (CategoriesList using useCategories, CriteriaList using useCriteria), each replicating CoordinatorCandidatesSection's loading-skeleton/isError/empty-state/desktop-grid+mobile-card structure and the CandidateStatus-shaped green/slate active badge. Modal open-state is 6 separate useState slots (isAddCategoryOpen/editCategoryTarget/deactivateCategoryTarget + the criterion equivalents) lifted into the top-level section component and passed down to the two list sub-components via callback props; all 6 modals are wired at the bottom of the section's JSX. Did not touch useCategories.ts, category.ts, Modal.tsx, or any FEAT-001/003/004 files. `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` both exit 0.
